criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Strong named tension in 10 words; gold '14 days' reads at 432 px; generic night lot art, busy lower half, gold cut competes with gold headline.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: 02 pays the cover; 06 to 09 escalate; 03 and 04 sag as dense evidence beats; 04 to 05 junction has no pull; D3 chain does not read as one chain.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: 07 masterful depth frame, 05 convincing carved-snow peak, 06 crisp paint lips; 08 luminaire and road flat, bokeh wallpaper; 09 doubled walls on the 4 and toy-like can; 03 flat store and hairline ruts; 01 and 04 crude car blocks.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: The paint law is a real semantic system; fourteen strips, sixty-minute trails, fourteen tread repeats, 238 and 11 discs, an unpainted 14; 03 and 08 need labels.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Named bodies, texts, outlets and dates; first-snow arc; honest scope; much of the art could be any US city.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Every content slide adds a verified specific; 08's 'it governs' leaned on a claim it did not list (since attached: C04, C81).

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: Surface labels all new; 'every frame a different instrument' is the third deck running and the dark navy plus single gold law is the house register.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Floors met; 01 and 07 fixtures crossed by seams and shadows; 06 small labels at thumb; 05 stencil foreshortened.

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: Hook lands with a definitional turn; closing question differs from slide 09's ask; 'it will govern city readers' presumes passage.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Post copy, three hashtags, dated first comment, title, aftercare, vector PDF, thumbs, contact sheet; Gmail draft and raw URLs need the merge; email must carry the Gas Watch WARN.
